body.short_description: Unable to access account after password reset

The crash happens without any error message, and the application must be force-closed. This is blocking the customer's ability to generate monthly compliance reports, which is a critical business process. The issue started occurring after the recent v8.2.0 update. Customer has already tried clearing temporary files, reinstalling the application, and running as administrator without resolution.

External USB keyboard works fine when connected, confirming the issue is isolated to the built-in keyboard. The laptop is approximately 18 months old and is still within the manufacturer's warranty period. Customer needs urgent assistance as they rely on this device for work and have important deadlines this week.
